title: Burns

source.name: MedlinePlus: Burns — U.S. National Library of Medicine

steps: Stop the burning. Remove the person from the source.
Cool the burn with cool, not ice-cold, running water.
Remove rings, watches and tight items before swelling starts.
Do not remove clothing that is stuck to the skin.
Cover the burn loosely with a clean, dry, non-stick dressing.
Do not apply butter, oil or home remedies.
Keep the person warm and watch for signs of shock.
callForHelp: Burns to face, hands, feet, groin or a major joint
Burns from electricity or chemicals, or trouble breathing
